name: app-store-connect
description: Manage App Store Connect reports and apps, and read verified purchase/refund evidence through a separate App Store Server API connection.

interface.shortDescription: Manage App Store Connect with a Python CLI.
interface.longDescription: Use a local Python CLI for App Store Connect reports and app management, plus separately authenticated, read-only App Store Server API transactions and refunds. Credentials stay in the OS secret store; signed purchase evidence is verified before export.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use App Store Connect to manage my apps and reports.
